text:
aaron: we should finalize preflight checks before autofallback executes. too many near-simultaneous policies led to surprise flips in staging yesterday.
sophia: agreed. proposal: a preflight API that returns an impact summary and a conflict flag. platform only applies if conflict==false or operator force.
lee: also add a quick risk score (low/medium/high) computed from affected_percent, sustain_confidence, and recent_retries. show it prominently.
ops-bot: alert: [AUTOFALLBACK-PREFLIGHT] eval_id=pref-20260502-01 service=chat-gen policy=latency-cutoff result=conflict=true conflicting_policies=[quota-fallback]
claire: UX idea: preflight modal with three panes: 1) what-if diff (weights + estimated latency/cost); 2) reasons & snapshot (metric peek); 3) conflicts & recommended action (merge, queue, cancel).
aaron: minimal policy schema additions (pseudo):
```yaml
preflight:
  require_preflight: true
  conflict_resolution: "queue_or_notify" # options: queue, merge, require_manual
  cooldown_after_apply: "15m"
  max_auto_actions_per_hour: 1
```
sophia: for telemetry we must include preflight_id in the event stream and attach it to sampled spans. helps correlate a later manual override to the original eval.
lee: edge-case: if two preflights run concurrently, one should reserve the pool with a short lease. avoid race where both think they're safe. show pending leases in UI.
claire: small UX thing: when conflict==true, show the minimal set of changes that would make the preflight pass (e.g., reduce step size from 30% to 10%, or increase stabilization). helps operators tweak without full policy edit.
devnull: implementation note: preflight should run as a dry-run in a sandbox routing layer and compute an immutable artifact (preflight_id -> snapshot + impact). store artifact for 72h for audits.
aaron: action items: (1) platform: preflight API + lease mechanism (lee/devnull), (2) telemetry: emit preflight.{requested,result,applied} with preflight_id (sophia), (3) console: preflight modal + suggested tweaks UI + conflict resolution flows (claire). i'll draft a short RFC and a tiny prototype next sprint.
ops-bot: reminder: add a runbook step "inspect preflight artifacts" for oncall.
